The '''Cerilia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Xappyh sector/Legends|Xappyh sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system shared its name with the [[Cerilian Trade Agreement]].<ref name="Three Against the Galaxy">{{Tales|3|Three Against the Galaxy}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Cerilia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square Q-3.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
